description:
Hyder's Reach

"Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder is a dangerous fleet admiral, a capable strategist, and a woman of firm and sincere convictions. Unfortunately, all the wrong ones."  -- Orcus Rao

"The problem with being a Sindrian is the company you have to keep." -- Louis "Space Em All" L'Amour

Every authoritarian regime, even those which are totalitarian panopticons built around a cult of personality, has someone who sincerely believes in the ideals professed by the regime, deploring those whose character betrays those high ideas...without realizing that the nature of the regime is precisely what is required for such characters to flourish.

Oxana Hyder didn't have her eyes "opened" by the "Macario Incident." She was already preparing for it, smuggling weapons and supplies to try to keep Sindria capably-defended.

In addition to that, Hyder has a problem: lack of supplies means that pirate raids and Luddic incursions must be repelled with the minimum possible losses.  She has collaborated with an unknown outside party (though the technology points to someone on Agreus) to create a dangerous variant of the Atropos torpedo, currently mounted on test frigates and destroyers within the Diktat's fleets. The updated version mates up the missile with a railgun cowling in order to expel the projectile at appalling speeds, immensely improving its range and speeds.

All of this has happened under the nose of both Macario and the Lion's Guard (which has no access to the weapon). The design is a master-stroke blending Midline and Low-tech engineering techniques, though fitting the cowling into existing missile racks is an immense and laborious process. If these tests were to work out and Sindrian mainliner fleets were to adopt a first-saturation-strike doctrine with them, the balance of power within the Askonian volume might be altered radically.

Technical notes: (ver. 1.0, stable)

The so-called "Hyder Atropos Torpedo" is a legitimate super-weapon, with exceptional speed and a deployment range on par with the Pilum. Hyder has managed to keep this secret from her competitors in the Diktat by having the weapons imported to her vessels directly - the torpedoes are not for sale and local arms merchants have no idea they exist.
OP costs for these weapons are trebled, which results in spectacularly sub-par loadouts for the ships using them. Only Hyder's personal intervention to build in missile-support hull modifications render the ships viable. An enterprising opponent, once they got wind of them, might try to hunt for a blueprint or salvage one from a wreck, but that would be the only way to obtain them short of tracking down Hyder's logistics chain. (This won't happen because I would need to be hand-held through how to create mission/quest chains in this system, lacking the hours required to climb up that learning curve myself).
If you're not picking up what I'm putting down here, this is a flavor mod to help the intentionally lackluster Diktat fleets keep you on your toes.  Your chances of personally getting your hands on these torpedoes are intentionally low for balance reasons. I haven't been a game developer in a long time, but one of my established principles of development work is that NPCs have agency just like the player does - this is a Core NPC "cheating" by pulling strings unavailable to the otherwise dauntingly-potent John Starsector.

[/list]

Download Here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GZZGfj9dLyoLK8D7YE6zkfn68MR9n--l?usp=sharing

aiDescription: Introduces a high-speed, long-range torpedo variant mounted on Sindrian frigates and destroyers. These weapons are exclusive to Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder and are not available for purchase or salvage. The mod aims to make the Sindrian Diktat fleets more challenging and strategically interesting by giving them a unique advantage.
